title: Preflight compatibility scan for tenant capacity, quotas, and network resources
creator: Avery Chen
description: Create an automated preflight compatibility scanner that validates tenant-specific requirements before a Private (VPC) install. The scanner will run a battery of checks across quotas, IAM, DNS, GPU SKU and capacity availability, networking (routes/MTU), and Terraform/Azure/GCP/AWS provider compatibility. It should emit a machine-readable summary for the Console and produce actionable remediation suggestions (playbooks and CLI commands) for SREs and onboarding engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Tool runs as a single CLI (or container) that can be executed from CI and by the onboarding wizard

Checks cover: compute quotas (per-region CPU/GPU), GPU SKU availability, IAM role assume-policy validation, DNS forward/reverse resolution tests, VPC route/peering sanity, subnet IP capacity, and Terraform provider & module version compatibility
Output includes structured JSON summary with per-check status (PASS/WARN/FAIL), severity, human-readable remediation, and suggested terraform resource diffs when applicable
Exit codes: 0 = all PASS/WARN-only, 2 = at least one FAIL (blocking); can be configured to treat WARNs as failures
Integrates with onboarding flow: results written to a Console ticket and linked in the install playbook
Provides dry-run terraform plan analysis and flags known incompatible module versions from our module registry
implementation_plan: Design check catalog and severity mapping (low/medium/high/blocking)
Prototype CLI skeleton and JSON output schema (match Console ingest format)
Implement cloud-specific quota queries for AWS/GCP/Azure using our existing IaC clients
Add GPU SKU discovery: query regional SKUs and capacity heuristics, cross-reference requested instance types
Implement IAM simulation: call sts:simulatePrincipalPolicy or equivalent to check required permissions and role trust policies
DNS checks: run forward and reverse lookups against configured VPC resolvers and target customer domains; validate Route53/Cloud DNS records existence
Network checks: probe VPC routes, ensure no overlapping CIDRs for peering, verify MTU and path MTU assumptions (for on-prem links)
Terraform checks: parse proto/lockfile, validate provider versions, run terraform init -upgrade dry-run in a sandboxed context to surface incompatible providers
Bundle remediation playbooks and CLI snippets for common failures (quota request template, IAM policy patches, terraform module update commands)
Add CI wrapper and tests; integrate with onboarding API to surface results in Console
test_plan: Unit tests for each check with mocked cloud APIs
End-to-end smoke tests against a reusable test tenant in sandbox clouds
Chaos tests: simulate API errors, rate limits, and partial data to ensure graceful degradation
Cross-cloud regression tests for Terraform module compatibility scenarios
Create a set of real-world failure fixtures (quota exhausted, missing IAM trust, DNS misconfigured) and ensure remediation steps are correct
